decision: Minimal-artifact bridge with idempotency_key as the sole jobId↔externalTaskId map (PK lookup on job.idempotency_key, no new table or migration), and a no-op deliver() for worker_lock_expired incidents (Flowable manages its own lock timeout; calling failTask while Choros retries creates split-brain). New module src/core/externalTaskBridge.ts: runBridgeOnce (one poll pass), startBridgePollLoop (образец lockReclaimer), makeExternalTaskDeliver (Deliver contract for outboxDispatcher). FF-G3 compliant (assertVariableValue + resolveFor in bridge file). Bridge is a library API — not auto-wired into server.ts by T-0067 (consistent with lockReclaimer; wiring deferred to T-0068 or explicit step).

rejected_alternatives.why_not: Unnecessary: job.idempotency_key IS the externalTaskId, already persisted, indexed, and PK-reverse-lookupable in O(1). A new table doubles storage, adds a migration, and pollutes known_tenant_tables.txt with no benefit.
Pollutes business payload with transport metadata; requires exempting the field from assertVariableValue guard. idempotency_key is the purpose-built carrier.

Creates split-brain when Choros has retriesLeft>0 (job re-queued as CREATED). Flowable terminates externally while Choros retries. Final completeTask hits NOT_FOUND (idempotentSuccess) but process instance already took the error path, not the completion path.

rejected_alternatives.option: Conditionally call failTask when worker_lock_expired and retriesLeft=0
rejected_alternatives.why_not: When retriesLeft=0, the sweep killed the job; the normal task_failed outbox row from the worker handles Flowable signaling if the worker already called fail. If the sweep force-killed it, Flowable's own engine-side retry counter fires independently. Calling failTask late races with engine-side incident logic. No-op is cleaner without loss of correctness.

function startBridgePollLoop(flowableClient: FlowableClient, jobStore: PostgresJobStore, opts: ExternalTaskBridgeConfig): { stop: () => void }
function makeExternalTaskDeliver(flowableClient: FlowableClient, jobStore: PostgresJobStore, workerId: string): Deliver
type Deliver = (row: OutboxRow) => Promise<DispatchResult>  — imported from outboxDispatcher.ts (T-0062)
deliver dispatch: 'task_completed' → completeTask; 'task_failed' → failTask; 'worker_lock_expired' | unknown → { ok: true } no-op
NOT_FOUND from Flowable on completeTask or failTask → { ok: false, idempotentSuccess: true } → outboxDispatcher marks 'dispatched'
async function lookupExternalTaskId(pool: pg.Pool, tenantId: string, jobId: string): Promise<string | undefined>  — internal; SELECT idempotency_key FROM choros.job WHERE id=$1 with GUC set
assertVariableValue called on every externalTask.variables[*] value before enqueue; failure → skip task, log incident, continue
resolveFor imported and void-referenced at completeTask payload-processing seam in externalTaskBridge.ts (FF-G3 structural requirement)
bridge file location: src/core/externalTaskBridge.ts (detected by flowable-bridge-contract.sh: src/core/flowable*.ts glob)
T-0068 seam: makeExternalTaskDeliver accepts optional onDispatched?: OnDispatched (passes through to runOutboxOnce opts); T-0067 passes undefined
